Falcon generates an EppDetectionSummaryEvent for each new endpoint detection alert. Not all EppDetectionSummaryEvent types include all the fields listed in
the table below.
Important details about this event type:
This event type is available to all customers. However, it corresponds to detection alerts viewed in the Endpoint detections page at Endpoint security >
Monitor > Endpoint detections that is being rolled out to customers in phases.
This event type has 2 fields that you can use to perform singular or bulk operations with the Alerts API, accessed using /alerts/ and discussed in
.
CompositeId: A global unique identifier that identifies a unique alert
AggregateId: A global unique identifier that links multiple alerts
For example, if you want to assign and update the status of a singular alert, you would call /alerts/ with a singular CompositeId. To assign and update the status
of a group of alerts, call /alerts/ with a filter query based on AggregateId.
